key_idea: Try every break length b from 0 upward and test whether working t-b minutes with a b-minute break is legal.
sketch: Work time is w=t-b. It is legal iff w<=600 and (w<=360, or w<=540 and b>=30, or b>=45). Loop b from 0 to t and print the first legal value; O(t). Pitfall: the thresholds apply to time worked, not time at work, so e.g. t=540 needs only 30 (510 worked), and for large t the 10-hour cap forces b=t-600. Samples pass with the checker.
